summary: A diary states what happened in short past-tense statements by the writer: where they went, who they met, what they paid.
realLife: Pepys's entries are first person and past tense, in short statements about where he went, who he saw and what he spent.
sources: Diary of Samuel Pepys, May 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/May
Diary of Samuel Pepys, January 1660, Wikisource: https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Diary_of_Samuel_Pepys/1660/January
